text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is a German politician.
MemberOfPrussianParliament(x) ::: x was a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOfReichstag(x) ::: x was a member of the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt :::
German(heinrich) ∧ Politician(heinrich) ∧ MemberOfPrussianParliament(heinrich) ∧ MemberOfReichstag(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician who was a member of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ MemberOfPrussianParliament(x) ∧ MemberOfReichstag(x)) ::: Some German politician was part of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
